prompt: An elegant editorial illustration of content integrity and reusable state in an automated publishing pipeline. Markdown documents and image assets pass through a luminous cryptographic fingerprint scanner; unchanged assets flow safely toward a cached destination while one changed image is routed through a new verification path. Show the idea through objects, branching light paths, matching fingerprint patterns, and color only. Modern dark engineering aesthetic, navy and teal with amber change highlights, clean 16:9 landscape composition. No readable screens, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks.
alt: 文章與圖片經 SHA-256 指紋辨識後重用未變資產並重新驗證變更內容
